items.title: Keep an eye on Georgia: Next data center flash point emerges after Texas
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down why Bernstein flagged Georgia as a place where AI data center approvals could slow and rules could tighten after the Democratic flip of its Georgia's Public Service Commission.

items.title: TSMC rises on report of potential push into advanced memory for Nvidia
items.summary: Investing.com -- Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing (NYSE:TSM) is evaluating an expansion into advanced memory chip production to capture a larger share of artificial intelligence infrastructure spending, according to a report from The Information. The initiative would mark a pivotal strategic evolution for the world’s dominant contract chipmaker, which has traditionally focused on pure-play logic fabrication.

items.title: Nvidia stock oversold setup: Key levels after a 9% drop
items.summary: Investing.com -- NVIDIA (NVDA) is rebounding after Thursday’s drop of 9.3%, its worst day since January 2025. All figures are as of Nov 6, 2026, 9:33 AM EST, early in the session. The stock is at $193.09 (+6.33%). Thursday’s close was $181.60, after an intraday low of $181.46.

items.title: Chip stocks lead tech rebound as SpaceX, Tesla jump: AlphaCheck
items.summary: Semiconductor stocks led a rebound in the tech sector on Friday, following a wipeout in AI-related stocks.

items.title: Iren stock rebounds as company's Q1 AI cloud revenue surges
items.summary: Iren shares rebounded on Friday as the provider of AI compute capacity reported a surge in its fiscal Q1 cloud revenue.

items.title: IREN stock soars, driven by massive gains in AI cloud sales
items.summary: IREN Ltd. (IREN) stock is surging higher after reporting that its AI cloud sales have doubled since last quarter. Interactive Brokers chief strategist Steve Sosnick and AInvest managing editor Adam Shapiro join Pras Subramanian to discuss IREN's post-earnings stock moves.
